g.text: Every score has a preservation check

text.style: font-size: 10px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #183348

g.text: E / tolerance ≤ 1 qualifies. Score credits retained-value reduction only after this preservation check passes.

text.style: font-size: 9.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #62788b

g.text: Raw observations retain every value and score 0. Scores are conditional on the declared target, tolerance and size contract.
